float in Latin

float · a swimming aid

cortex, corticis m.

Ancient LatinQuotationsComposed phrasesDraft
  • cortex, corticis m. — a float, cork classical (Hor. S. 1.4.120: nābis sine cortice, “you’ll swim without a float”)
  • Corticem tenē; aqua tē feret. — Hold the float; the water will carry you. composed

See also: life jacket, armbands, swimming.
